reason: The patch adds bare awaits on dynamic import() promises with no try/catch, for example packages/app-store/_utils/getCalendar.ts:15 (`await appStore[...]`), getVideoAdapters in packages/core/videoClient.ts, and the payment lookups in packages/lib/payment/handlePayment.ts and deletePayment.ts. This is a minor issue because a missing module would also have crashed the old static imports at load time, and index.ts starts every import() immediately.
